question: Identify users who satisfy all of the following: (1) they own at least one well-finished post (i.e., ClosedDate IS NOT NULL), (2) they have commented on a post tagged with 'humor', and (3) they received a badge in the same year that they posted that comment. Return their display names along with the name of the badge awarded in that matching year.

prediction.sql: SELECT u."XCL_055", b."XCL_003" FROM users AS u JOIN comments AS c ON c."XCL_010" = u."XCL_052" JOIN posts AS p2 ON c."XCL_006" = p2."XCL_026" JOIN tags AS t ON t."XCL_050" = p2."XCL_026" JOIN badges AS b ON b."XCL_002" = u."XCL_052" WHERE t."XCL_048" = 'humor' AND STRFTIME('%Y', b."XCL_004") = STRFTIME('%Y', c."XCL_009") AND u."XCL_052" IN (SELECT p1."XCL_033" FROM posts AS p1 WHERE NOT p1."XCL_044" IS NULL)

arguments.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055", b."XCL_003"
FROM users AS u
JOIN comments AS c ON c."XCL_010" = u."XCL_052"
JOIN posts AS p2 ON c."XCL_006" = p2."XCL_026"
JOIN tags AS t ON t."XCL_050" = p2."XCL_026"
JOIN badges AS b ON b."XCL_002" = u."XCL_052"
WHERE t."XCL_048" = 'humor'
  AND strftime('%Y', b."XCL_004") = strftime('%Y', c."XCL_009")
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM posts AS p1
    WHERE p1."XCL_033" = u."XCL_052"
      AND p1."XCL_044" IS NOT NULL
  )
